items.name: b12061
items.body:
<details open>

mtmd: Pocket tts - support for voices without voice cloning (#31429)

* feat: support PocketTTS voices with no voice cloning

The kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning weights ship predefined voices as the
backbone KV state after the voice prompt. The converter turns each state back into
the prompt embeddings and stores them in the mmproj (voice.<name>), the zeroed voice
encoder is left out, and the "voice" field of /tts and --tts-voice select one of them.
A speaker reference is rejected when the model has no voice encoder.

Assisted-by: Claude Fable 5.1

* convert : pocket-tts voices never fail the conversion, log the drift of the state

The voice states shipped by Kyutai are not always the ones the pack's
weights give for the prompt: italian, german and spanish match within the
bf16 rounding, english_2026-04 is 2% off and french 20% (its layer 0 state
comes from other weights), while the reference loads them as is and they
still sound like the same voice. The converter now re-prompts the backbone
with the recovered embeddings, compares the whole state and logs the
distance per voice, warning above 5%. A state that does not belong to the
weights at all is skipped, so the packs of kyutai/pocket-tts convert too.

Assisted-by: Claude Fable 5.1

* mtmd : list the predefined voices, expose them in GET /props

mtmd_gen_audio_info gains n_voices and mtmd_gen_audio_voice_name() the
names, with the voices worded as a feature of any audio generation model.
The server lists them under "voices" in /props when the model ships some.

Assisted-by: Claude Fable 5.1

* server : an unknown voice is a bad request

A model with predefined voices answers 400 naming the voice instead of 500
"failed to process TTS prompt". A model without them ignores "voice" with a
warning

items.name: b12059
items.body:
<details open>

llama : flash_attn_ext_rows - more efficient unified kv for multi-seq (#29510)

* llama : use llm_attn_mask and kv_rows for unified attention

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp-GGUF (Mac Studio, M2 Ultra, 192GB)

Co-authored-by: Georgi Gerganov <ggerganov@gmail.com>

* cont : optimize `get_seq_cells`

* llama : build the kv_rows lists from per-sequence cell bitmaps

Keep a bitmap over the cells for each sequence (the transpose of `seq`), updated in seq_pos_inc/dec, and build the cell lists by walking its set bits. The lists stay in cell order, cells shared by several sequences go to every list, and nothing has to be rebuilt when cells are removed.

Also leave out of the lists the cells that the SWA hides from every token of the slice (standard and chunked SWA).

* cont : make get_kv_rows_p_min private

* cont : minor metal

* llama : use kv_rows for every ubatch of a unified cache

A ubatch made of equal-length runs with a single sequence each (f.ex. the drafts of several slots) now splits into per-sequence slices.

Any other ubatch (interleaved, uneven or coupled sequences) becomes a single slice over the cells of all its sequences instead of falling back to the dense KQ mask, so the graph keeps the topology of the reserved graph.

* llama : merge get_kv_rows_seq_ids and get_kv_rows_p_min into get_kv_rows_slices

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB)

---------

Co-authored-by: Georgi Gerganov <ggerganov@gmail.com>

</details>
